title: Noa daily-life vlogs: after work, a Saturday walk, the sea, the end of the day
user_request_verbatim: 이제 난 잘거야. 7시간 정도 소요되는 작업을 해. ... Noa의 일상 브이로그를 몇개 만들어봐. 퇴근 후 마트에 가서 저녁 찬거리를 사가지고 오는거나, 주말에 집근처 산책하는 거, 여름 해변에서 물놀이를 하는 모습, 자기 위해 잠옷을 갈아입고 침대에 눕는 장면 정도
source_idea: Four vlogs of five shots each, twenty clips at about eighteen minutes apiece. Built on what the self-introduction established: H3 generates speech and lip sync so no TTS is involved; framing must be described by where the crop falls, because 'a medium shot with the street behind her' produced a figure a tenth of the frame while 'holds her head and shoulders' produced a close-up; and face size in frame, not the change of location, is what moved the identity score, so these stay at medium-close or closer. The delivery sentence is the first attempt at the operator's note that the voice sounded American and like a first take and that later work should sound practised. Wardrobe, locations and content all come from scene_defaults. The bedtime vlog is a getting-ready-for-bed routine with her already in nightwear.
